poem.author: 杜甫
englishLines: Good rain knows the right season,
Arriving when spring begins to grow.
It slips into the night with the wind,
While one light shines from a riverboat.
At dawn, look where red blossoms are wet,
Heavy with rain across the City of Brocade.

appreciation.zh: 春雨在最需要的时候悄悄到来，夜里看不清田野，只见江船一点灯火。诗人已经开始想象清晨：满城花朵带着雨珠，颜色会更加鲜亮。
appreciation.en: Spring rain arrives quietly when the growing world needs it. A lone boat light shines through the dark night, and the poet imagines dawn flowers bright and heavy with raindrops.

pages.zhText:
好雨知时节，
当春乃发生。
随风潜入夜，
润物细无声。
野径云俱黑，
江船火独明。
晓看红湿处，
花重锦官城。
pages.enText:
Good rain knows the right season,
Arriving when spring begins to grow.
It slips into the night with the wind,
Moistening everything softly and silently.
Clouds darken every country path,
While one light shines from a riverboat.
At dawn, look where red blossoms are wet,
Heavy with rain across the City of Brocade.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Gentle spring night rain over Tang-era Chengdu outskirts, a kind Tang poet in dark teal robe watches from a sheltered wooden veranda, wet garden shoots and red buds, dark field path and one warm riverboat lantern in distance, rain delicate, no text.

pages.zhText:
好雨知时节，
当春乃发生。
春天的草木正要生长，一场及时的雨就来了。
pages.enText:
Good rain knows the right season,
Arriving when spring begins to grow.
Just as spring plants begin growing, the timely rain arrives.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Early evening in same garden, first fine raindrops touch tender seedlings and swelling flower buds, same poet reaches one hand from under eave to feel rain, delighted and dry, no text.

pages.zhText:
随风潜入夜，
润物细无声。
细雨跟着春风走进夜色，轻轻滋润每一片叶子。
pages.enText:
It slips into the night with the wind,
Moistening everything softly and silently.
Fine rain rides the breeze and quietly waters every leaf.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Intimate night view of fine rain drifting sideways through same garden, droplets bead on leaves, soil darkens and roots drink, same poet listening quietly under veranda, soft wind, no storm or text.

pages.zhText:
野径云俱黑，
江船火独明。
乌云遮住天空和小路，远处江船的一点灯火却亮着。
pages.enText:
Clouds darken every country path,
While one light shines from a riverboat.
Clouds cover the path, but one boat light glows across the river.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Wide dark-blue rainy landscape, country path and clouds blend softly into night, one single warm lantern glows on a small safe riverboat, same poet silhouetted under roof at foreground, high contrast but comforting, no text.

pages.zhText:
晓看红湿处，
花重锦官城。
等到天亮，带着雨珠的红花会沉甸甸地开满锦官城。
pages.enText:
At dawn, look where red blossoms are wet,
Heavy with rain across the City of Brocade.
By morning, red flowers will open across the city, heavy with raindrops.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Fresh dawn reveal in same Tang city garden and lanes, abundant red blossoms bow slightly under clear raindrops, same poet walks joyfully among them, pale mist lifting, no text.

pages.zhText: 雨没有敲锣打鼓，只在黑夜里轻轻落下。泥土、嫩芽和花苞，都安静地喝饱了水。
pages.enText: The rain makes no fuss; it falls softly through the night. Soil, shoots, and buds quietly drink their fill.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Cutaway-like but poetic garden scene from soil to leaves, gentle rain feeds roots, seedlings and buds while same poet sleeps safely indoors behind paperless lattice window glow, no labels or text.

pages.zhText: 诗人还没看见清晨的花，就已经在心里看见了。期待让漆黑的雨夜，也藏着明亮的颜色。
pages.enText: Before dawn arrives, the poet already sees the flowers in his mind. Hope hides bright colors inside the dark rainy night.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Contemplative same poet at dark veranda, warm imagination of dawn red blossoms appears naturally in reflected puddle and soft mist, one boat light remains distant, no supernatural portal, no text.

pages.zhText:
好雨知时节，
当春乃发生。
随风潜入夜，
润物细无声。
野径云俱黑，
江船火独明。
晓看红湿处，
花重锦官城。
再轻轻读一遍吧。
pages.enText:
Good rain knows the right season,
Arriving when spring begins to grow.
It slips into the night with the wind,
Moistening everything softly and silently.
Clouds darken every country path,
While one light shines from a riverboat.
At dawn, look where red blossoms are wet,
Heavy with rain across the City of Brocade.
Now read it softly once more.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Closing sunrise after rain over same Tang city and river, countless wet red flowers glow, boat returns through bright mist, same poet smiles beneath clearing sky, no text.
